verdict.rationale: Elastic Observability is an observability platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The closest items are the in-product natural-language interface, the nightshift AI SRE, llms.txt and the ES|QL REST API, and none of these is an MCP server an external agent can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
